paragraphs: Welcome to our Kwanzaa clipart collection, with {{artworkCount}} illustrations to explore. Explore Kwanzaa symbols, woven objects and scenes of people cooking, crafting and helping together. The collection ranges from a seven-candle kinara and carved unity cup to book gifts, percussion players and black-and-white community scenes.

The gallery includes “Carved Wooden Kinara With Seven Candles” and “Carrying Produce Through a Garden Gate” among its drawings. Pair the artwork with your own words for a personal Kwanzaa greeting, a family reflection page or a cultural learning display.
